THE RHYTHM, EXPLAINED

A streak has a price.

A swap with at least 0.001 ETH on its pool delta advances the streak. The next swap in that direction pays 0.10% more, from a 0.30% base up to 2.00%.

A qualifying swap in the opposite direction starts a new streak. Smaller swaps pay the directional fee but leave the streak unchanged. Resetting with a counter-swap costs two hook fees plus LP fees for the round trip.
